title: memcache: Use ws_buftou
description:
This passes in the end pointer but doesn't use it, in order to
preserve the existing behavior. (But perhaps error-checking would
be a good idea?)

In addition to removing all the memcpys, this also fixes a couple of
cases where a 64-bit field would be clamped on Windows and any other
platform where a long is 32-bit. checkAPIs.pl doesn't allow strtoull,
since Windows didn't have it, but now that we require versions of
the Windows run time that have strtoull that's actually safer than
strtoul for that issue. Neither are locale independent, though (locale
affects what is considered whitespace at the beginning, for example).

AI-Assisted: no
